## Bugphyzz data

```{r import bp, message=FALSE}
## importBugphyzz() keeps an attribute's imputed (ASR) annotations when the
## lower 95% bound of its cross-validated kappa is at least 0.7 (R2 0.5 for
## numeric attributes) and the row's Score is at least 0.5: bugphyzzExports
## ADR 0006, in bugphyzz since 1.7.15. The exported files are already filtered
## the same way.
bp <- importBugphyzz(version = params$bugphyzz_version) |>
    map(~ mutate(.x, NCBI_ID = as.character(NCBI_ID)))
## The installed bugphyzz ships the validation tables of the release it
## defaults to, so only other releases need their own tables
bugphyzz_default <- tryCatch(
    eval(formals(bugphyzz::importBugphyzz)$version),
    error = function(e) NA_character_
)
## Cross-validation table (taxPProValidation): the installed package's copy
## unless params$validation_tsv points to another version
validation <- if (nzchar(params$validation_tsv)) {
    readr::read_tsv(params$validation_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
    if (!params$bugphyzz_version %in% c("devel", bugphyzz_default)) {
        warning(
            "validation_tsv is empty, so Figure 2 and the attributes table use ",
            "the validation_summary.tsv shipped with bugphyzz ",
            packageVersion("bugphyzz"), ", which may not be the version the ",
            params$bugphyzz_version, " release was filtered with."
        )
    }
    ## bugphyzz exports no accessor for these tables
    readr::read_tsv(
        system.file("extdata", "validation_summary.tsv", package = "bugphyzz"),
        show_col_types = FALSE
    )
}
## Per-attribute scores (ADR 0006): these decide which attributes are imputed
validation_attr <- if (nzchar(params$validation_attributes_tsv)) {
    readr::read_tsv(params$validation_attributes_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
    if (!params$bugphyzz_version %in% c("devel", bugphyzz_default)) {
        warning(
            "validation_attributes_tsv is empty, so the imputation decisions ",
            "come from the table shipped with bugphyzz ",
            packageVersion("bugphyzz"), ", which may not be the version the ",
            params$bugphyzz_version, " release was filtered with."
        )
    }
    f <- system.file("extdata", "validation_attributes.tsv", package = "bugphyzz")
    if (!nzchar(f)) {
        stop(
            "The installed bugphyzz has no extdata/validation_attributes.tsv; ",
            "it needs version 1.7.15 or later, or set validation_attributes_tsv."
        )
    }
    readr::read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
}
## The threshold follows the metric, not a list of attribute names: R2 for
## numeric attributes, kappa (weighted where the states are ordered) for the
## rest. `imputed` is the attribute-level decision; individual imputed rows
## must also have Score >= 0.5, which importBugphyzz() applies.
validation_attr <- validation_attr |>
    filter(rank == "all") |>
    mutate(
        threshold = ifelse(metric == "r2", 0.5, 0.7),
        imputed = score_lcb >= threshold
    )
stopifnot(all(validation_attr$metric %in% c("r2", "kappa", "weighted kappa")))
length(bp)
```
```{r}
myDataTable(data.frame(attributes = names(bp)), page_len = length(bp))
```

## Totals

```{r totals}
## Number of unique taxa
n_taxa <- map(bp, ~ .x$NCBI_ID) |> 
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) |> 
    unique() |> 
    length()

## Number of annotations
n_annotations <- map_int(bp, nrow) |> 
    sum()

## Number of physiologies/attribute groups
n_attr <- length(bp)

## Number of sources
n_sources <- map(bp, ~ {
    unique(.x$Attribute_source) |> 
        {\(y) y[!is.na(y)]}()
}) |> 
    unlist(recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE) |> 
    unique() |> 
    length()

## Number of annotations from sources
n_annotations_source <- map_int(bp, ~ {
    .x |> 
        filter(!is.na(Attribute_source)) |> 
        nrow()
}) |> 
    sum()

## Number of annotations IBD
n_annotations_ibd <- map_int(bp, ~ {
    .x |> 
        filter(Evidence == "tax") |> 
        nrow()
}) |> 
    sum()

## Number of annotations ASR
n_annotations_asr <- map_int(bp, ~ {
    .x |> 
        filter(Evidence == "asr") |> 
        nrow()
}) |> 
    sum()

## Number of 
num_vs_dis_n <- map_chr(bp, ~ {
    unique(.x$Attribute_type)
}) |> 
    table() |> 
    as.data.frame() |> 
    set_names(c("name", "n")) |> 
    mutate(name = ifelse(name == "numeric", "numeric", "discrete")) |> 
    count(name, wt = n)

attr_asr_default_names <- map(bp, ~ {
    unique(.x$Evidence)
}) |> 
    keep(~ "asr" %in% .x) |> 
    names()

attr_asr_default <- length(attr_asr_default_names)

attr_asr_all <- validation_attr |>
    pull(physiology) |>
    unique() |>
    length()

count_summary_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
    ~name, ~n,
    "Number of taxa", n_taxa,
    "Number of annotations", n_annotations,
    "Number of attributes", n_attr,
    "Number of discrete attributes", pull(filter(num_vs_dis_n, name == "discrete"),n),
    "Number of sources", n_sources,
    "Number of annoations from sources", n_annotations_source,
    "Number of IBD annotations", n_annotations_ibd,
    "Number of annotations imputed through ASR", n_annotations_asr,
    "Number of attributes with imputed (ASR) annotations", attr_asr_default,
    "Number of attributes cross-validated for imputation", attr_asr_all
)

myDataTable(count_summary_tbl)
```

## Totals by rank

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
valid_ranks <- c(
    "superkingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family",
    "genus", "species", "strain"
)
attr_order <- names(sort(map_int(bp, nrow), decreasing = TRUE))
counts_rank <- bp |> 
    map(~ count(.x, Attribute, Rank)) |> 
    bind_rows() |> 
    mutate(Attribute = factor(Attribute, levels = attr_order)) |> 
    mutate(Rank = factor(Rank, levels = valid_ranks))
p_counts_rank <- counts_rank |> 
    ggplot(aes(Attribute, n)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = Rank), position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_discrete(name = "Rank") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
        x = "Attribute", y = "No. annotations"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
p_counts_rank
```

## Total number of annotations by type of Evidence

```{r}
count_types <- bp |> 
    map (~{
        .x |> 
            mutate(
                Type = case_when(
                    Evidence %in% c("exp", "igc", "nas", "tas") ~ "Source",
                    Evidence == "asr" ~ "ASR",
                    Evidence == "tax" ~ "IBD"
                )
            ) |> 
            count(Attribute, Type)
}) |> 
    bind_rows()


keep_attrs <- split(count_types, count_types$Attribute) |> 
    keep( ~ {
        types <- unique(.x$Type)
        "IBD" %in% types | "ASR" %in% types
    }) |> 
    names()

    filter(Attribute %in% keep_attrs) |> 
    mutate(Attribute = factor(Attribute, levels = attr_order)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(Attribute, n)) +

    labs(

    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
```

# Figure: 10-fold cross-validation and counts per evidence type (species)

Create plot of MMC values for discrete attributes:

```{r}
# val_fname <- "/home/samuelgamboa/Projects/taxPProValidation/validation_summary.tsv"
```

```{r validation discrete}
val <- validation |>
filter(rank == "all") # Validation including taxa of mixed ranks as input (keyword is "all")
## with_ties = FALSE: two values of one attribute can share the top score
## (COGEM ratings 1 and 2 in v1.0.7), which would duplicate a factor level
dis_phys_names <- val |> 
    filter(!is.na(mcc_mean)) |> 
    group_by(physiology) |> 
    slice_max(order_by = mcc_mean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
    arrange(-mcc_mean) |> 
    pull(physiology)
pValDis <- val |> # plot Validation Discrete
    filter(!is.na(mcc_mean))  |> 
    mutate(ltp_bp = ifelse(is.na(ltp_bp), ltp_bp_phys, ltp_bp)) |> 
    mutate(physiology = factor(physiology, levels = dis_phys_names)) |>
    mutate(
        guide_col = ifelse(
            as.character(physiology) == attribute,
            as.character(physiology),
            paste0(as.character(physiology), "|", attribute)
        )
    ) |> 
    arrange(physiology, mcc_mean) |> 
    ggplot(aes(forcats::fct_inorder(guide_col), mcc_mean, group = attribute)) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = mcc_mean - mcc_sd, ymax = mcc_mean + mcc_sd),
        position = position_dodge(0.5),
        width = 0, linewidth = 0.3
        
    ) +
    geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0.7, linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.2,
        color = "red"
    ) +
    geom_point(
        aes(size = ltp_bp),
        shape = 23, position = position_dodge(0.5), fill = "white"
        # size = 2
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "tips annotated") +
    scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = round(
            seq(
                min(val$mcc_mean - val$mcc_sd, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.1,
                max(val$mcc_mean + val$mcc_sd, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1,
                0.2),
            1)
    ) +
    labs(
        y = "Matthews Correlation Coefficient",
        x = "Attribute|Attribute value"
    ) +
    theme_bw()  +
    theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        
    ) +
    coord_flip()
```

```{r counts species}
    )
```

# Supplementary Table: attributes

One row per attribute: type, unit, number of sources, annotations by evidence
(curated from a source, IBD = inherited from strains by taxonomy, ASR), taxa,
and the cross-validation score at rank "all" that decides whether the
attribute is imputed: the lower 95% bound of its distance-matched Cohen's
kappa, or of its R2 for numeric attributes (bugphyzzExports ADR 0006).
Attributes at or above the threshold, 0.7 and 0.5, carry imputed annotations
in the release, except individual rows whose `Score` is below 0.5.

```{r supp table attributes}
val_str <- validation_attr |>
    mutate(
        `Validation (rank all)` = sprintf(
            "%s %.2f (lower bound %.2f, %s)", metric, score_mean, score_lcb,
            ifelse(imputed, "imputed", "not imputed")
        ),
        Attribute = tolower(physiology)   # the export lowercases attribute names
    ) |>
    select(Attribute, `Validation (rank all)`)
supp_attr_tbl <- bp |>
    map(~ {
        .x |>
            summarise(
                Type = unique(Attribute_type)[1],
                Unit = if ("Unit" %in% names(.x)) paste(unique(na.omit(Unit)), collapse = ";") else "",
                Sources = n_distinct(Attribute_source[!is.na(Attribute_source)]),
                Curated = sum(Evidence %in% c("exp", "igc", "tas", "nas")),
                IBD = sum(Evidence == "tax"),
                ASR = sum(Evidence == "asr"),
                Total = n(),
                Taxa = n_distinct(NCBI_ID)
            )
    }) |>
    bind_rows(.id = "Attribute") |>
    mutate(.key = tolower(Attribute)) |>
    left_join(val_str, by = c(".key" = "Attribute")) |>
    select(-.key) |>
    arrange(desc(Total))
## every annotation is curated, IBD or ASR, and every attribute with ASR
## annotations has a validation score to show for them
stopifnot(
    all(supp_attr_tbl$Curated + supp_attr_tbl$IBD + supp_attr_tbl$ASR == supp_attr_tbl$Total),
    !any(supp_attr_tbl$ASR > 0 & is.na(supp_attr_tbl$`Validation (rank all)`))
)
myDataTable(supp_attr_tbl, page_len = nrow(supp_attr_tbl))
```

# Supplementary Table: agreement between sources

The release credits each value to one source, so it cannot show how often
sources overlap. This table is computed from the curated inputs instead:
`physiologies()` reads every source before conflicts are resolved. The
programmatic sources come from `sources/` of bugphyzzExports at
`params$sources_ref`; the curation sheets are read as they are today and
cannot be pinned. As in the export, the 2020 Bergey's Manual rows and the rows
in `sources/sheet_overrides.tsv` are left out.

Only attributes with mutually exclusive states are compared (binary and
multistate-intersection). For each attribute, a taxon counts once per source,
with the set of states that source gives it. "Identical" means all sources
give the same set; "share a state" means at least one state is common to all
of them. The first table matches on the NCBI taxid as curated; in the second,
strain rows are moved to their parent species first, so that strain-level
sources (BacDive) meet species-level ones, and a source's states for a
species are those of all its strains.

```{r source agreement, eval = nzchar(params$sources_ref)}
sources_base <- paste0(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldronlab/bugphyzzExports/",
    params$sources_ref, "/sources/"
)
## physiologies() reads this option (bugphyzz >= 1.7.5) and keys its cache
## on it; restored even if the import fails
old_opt <- options(bugphyzz.sourcesBaseUrl = sources_base)
phys <- tryCatch(physiologies("all"), finally = options(old_opt))
sheets_read_on <- Sys.Date()
sheet_ov <- readr::read_tsv(
    paste0(sources_base, "sheet_overrides.tsv"),
    col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c")
)
curated_inputs <- map(phys, ~ {
    .x |>
        mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
        select(any_of(c(
            "NCBI_ID", "Rank", "Parent_NCBI_ID", "Parent_rank", "Attribute",
            "Attribute_value", "Attribute_group", "Attribute_type",
            "Attribute_source", "Frequency"
        )))
}) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    filter(
        !is.na(NCBI_ID), NCBI_ID != "", !is.na(Attribute_source),
        Attribute_source != "Bergey's Manual",
        Attribute_type %in% c("binary", "multistate-intersection"),
        !Frequency %in% "never"
    ) |>
    anti_join(
        sheet_ov,
        by = c(
            "Attribute_group" = "physiology", "NCBI_ID", "Attribute",
            "Attribute_value", "Attribute_source"
        )
    ) |>
    ## a multistate row with FALSE says a state is absent; only stated
    ## states are compared
    filter(Attribute_type == "binary" | Attribute_value == "TRUE") |>
    mutate(state = ifelse(Attribute_type == "binary", Attribute_value, Attribute))

sourceAgreement <- function(dat) {
    per_source <- dat |>
        group_by(Attribute_group, NCBI_ID, Attribute_source) |>
        summarise(states = list(sort(unique(state))), .groups = "drop")
    per_taxon <- per_source |>
        group_by(Attribute_group, NCBI_ID) |>
        summarise(
            n_sources = n(),
            identical = length(unique(map_chr(states, paste, collapse = "|"))) == 1,
            share = length(Reduce(intersect, states)) > 0,
            .groups = "drop"
        )
    per_taxon |>
        group_by(Attribute = Attribute_group) |>
        summarise(
            Taxa = n(),
            `Taxa with 2+ sources` = sum(n_sources >= 2),
            `Taxa with 3+ sources` = sum(n_sources >= 3),
            Identical = sum(identical & n_sources >= 2),
            `Share a state` = sum(share & n_sources >= 2),
            .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        filter(`Taxa with 2+ sources` > 0) |>
        mutate(
            `Identical (%)` = round(100 * Identical / `Taxa with 2+ sources`, 1),
            `Share a state (%)` = round(100 * `Share a state` / `Taxa with 2+ sources`, 1),
            `No state shared (%)` = round(100 - `Share a state (%)`, 1)
        ) |>
        arrange(desc(`Taxa with 2+ sources`))
}
## fixture: taxon 1 identical, 2 partial overlap, 3 disjoint, 4 one source
fx <- tibble::tribble(
    ~Attribute_group, ~NCBI_ID, ~Attribute_source, ~state,
    "g", "1", "A", "x", "g", "1", "B", "x",
    "g", "2", "A", "x", "g", "2", "A", "y", "g", "2", "B", "x",
    "g", "3", "A", "x", "g", "3", "B", "y",
    "g", "4", "A", "x"
)
fx_out <- sourceAgreement(fx)
stopifnot(
    fx_out$Taxa == 4, fx_out$`Taxa with 2+ sources` == 3,
    fx_out$Identical == 1, fx_out$`Share a state` == 2
)
agreement_taxid <- sourceAgreement(curated_inputs)
agreement_species <- curated_inputs |>
    mutate(
        to_species = Rank %in% "strain" & Parent_rank %in% "species" &
            !is.na(Parent_NCBI_ID),
        NCBI_ID = ifelse(to_species, Parent_NCBI_ID, NCBI_ID)
    ) |>
    sourceAgreement()
stopifnot(
    all(agreement_taxid$Identical <= agreement_taxid$`Share a state`),
    all(agreement_species$Identical <= agreement_species$`Share a state`)
)
```

Matched on the taxid as curated:

```{r source agreement taxid, eval = nzchar(params$sources_ref)}
myDataTable(agreement_taxid, page_len = nrow(agreement_taxid))
```

Strains moved to their parent species:

```{r source agreement species, eval = nzchar(params$sources_ref)}
myDataTable(agreement_species, page_len = nrow(agreement_species))
```

The curation sheets were read on `r if (nzchar(params$sources_ref)) format(sheets_read_on) else "(section skipped)"`.
Sources are not all independent: some compile others, so agreement is an upper
bound on independent confirmation. Rows without a rank in the curated inputs
stay at their own taxid in the second table.

```{r write supp tables, include = FALSE}
## TSV copies for the manuscript supplement
out_dir <- if (nzchar(params$out_dir)) params$out_dir else tempdir()
readr::write_tsv(supp_attr_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "supplementary_table_attributes.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(sources, file.path(out_dir, "supplementary_table_sources.tsv"))
if (nzchar(params$sources_ref)) {
    readr::write_tsv(agreement_taxid, file.path(out_dir, "supplementary_table_source_agreement_taxid.tsv"))
    readr::write_tsv(agreement_species, file.path(out_dir, "supplementary_table_source_agreement_species.tsv"))
}
message("Supplementary tables written to ", out_dir)
```
